name: Nostr
description: Nostr on the GNOME desktop: a Quick Settings toggle for the per-user session relay (same on/off semantics as Nostr Settings) with live relay statistics, message-notification status, your Nostr Wallet Connect balance a shortcut to Nostr Settings, and a Grotto signer panel indicator (coarse status and pending count only; signing approvals stay in Grotto). Needs the nostrc session relay; the wallet line needs nostr-wallet-agent.
